_comment: World B usage-aware cascade. Routing policy lives in routing-policy.json; this file supplies the executable cascade classes. A chunk's executor intent maps to a class here; cascade-dispatch.sh walks that class's role ladder, resolves roles per host via harness-profile.json, checks live headroom (usage-probe.sh) + the quality_floor, dispatches the best available rung, and on a cap error fires the Airlift Tier-1 checkpoint and DESCENDS. OpenRouter mechanical-agent routing in dm-review reads the same policy; DeepSeek names are model slugs, never a separate provider.

class_from_kind._comment: Coding kind -> cascade class. Config/docs go OpenRouter-primary; logic, ui, and integration go Codex-primary.

quality_rank._comment: Global model->compatibility score; enforces quality_floor regardless of which role surfaced the model. Ordered role lists remain the routing authority; this is not a ranking engine.
quality_rank._comment_gpt56: GPT-5.6 (Sol/Terra/Luna, GA 2026-07-09) supersedes GPT-5.5. These bare names remain on the native Codex subscription rail.
quality_rank._comment_codex_mini: gpt-5.1-codex-mini keeps a rank so a stray re-add scores above the codex floor rather than silently resolving to 0, but it appears in NO ladder: `codex exec --model gpt-5.1-codex-mini` returns HTTP 400 'not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account', and the codex host runs on the ChatGPT sub. Do not re-add it to harness-profile.json.
quality_rank._comment_kimi_k3: Kimi K3 is reserved for focused applicable security review and appears in no ordinary Pipeline ladder. The checked-in ranks are compatibility floors, while ordered role lists decide routing.

codex._comment: Primary executor = Codex for logic, UI, and integration. When Codex caps, descend through agentic OpenRouter and then wrapper models.

openrouter._comment: Primary executor = OpenRouter for config/docs/mechanical logic. Codex is the trusted coding fallback, followed by wrapper models.

policy._comment_headroom: Treat a sub/native rail as exhausted once probed remaining quota drops below this -- hand off BEFORE the hard wall (mirrors Airlift's early-warning trip).
policy._comment_reentry: When an exhausted sub rail's resets_at passes it re-enters at its original ladder position (flat-rate and free again -- prefer quality).
policy._comment_subscriptions: Coding rails: Codex Pro 20x is the active flat-rate workhorse, with a named 5x profile; OpenRouter carries external agentic and mechanical work.
policy._comment_fable: Fable 5 keeps its quality score for research, judgment, and review lanes. Fable is routed explicitly for permitted non-coding work rather than by ladder descent.
policy._comment_native_host_constraint: GPT-5.6 Sol is native Codex only and remains the preferred coding head. Terra and Luna OpenRouter calls are explicit policy-routed review/direct workloads rather than replacements in the host fallback ladder.
policy.privacy: DEMOTED (2026-07-18, user directive): model selection priority is Quality > Price > Speed > Provider privacy. OPENROUTER_ZDR is OPT-IN, never a default pin -- Chinese first-party hosting (Moonshot/DeepSeek/Z.AI) is acceptable by default. Set OPENROUTER_ZDR=1 per-call only for genuinely sensitive material (client code under NDA, credentials-adjacent diffs); when set, a model with no eligible ZDR provider (e.g. moonshotai/kimi-k3 pre-weights) is a per-model failure and the ladder walks on.
policy._comment_headroom_unknown: A subscription rail has headroom only when its probe object is well-formed, state is exactly 'ok', and numeric remaining_pct is above headroom_threshold_pct. Unknown, missing, malformed, at-threshold, limited, and low subscription readings are unavailable. OpenRouter is an auto-reloading API balance rail and is available only with state exactly 'ok' plus finite non-negative balance_usd; the retired $5 minimum must not be restored. Reactive failure detection is a backstop, never a substitute for positive evidence.
policy._comment_agentic_seam: openrouter_exec is the agentic OpenRouter rung for config/docs/mechanical-logic. Wrapper rungs (cheap_api/frontier_api) remain single-turn analysis/text generation and are still invalid for complex logic/ui/integration implementation.
